properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.enabled
properties.description: Whether to sync schema from entities on startup.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.mode
properties.description: Sync mode: none / validate / update / create / create-drop.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.packages
properties.description: Packages to scan for @SqlTable / JPA / MyBatis-Plus entities.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.entities
properties.description: Explicit entity class names, in addition to scanned packages.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.dialect
properties.description: Target dialect name; inferred from the JDBC URL when absent.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.url
properties.description: JDBC URL used when no DataSource bean is available; falls back to spring.datasource.url.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.username
properties.description: JDBC username for the DriverManager path.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.password
properties.description: JDBC password for the DriverManager path.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.driver
properties.description: JDBC driver class name; inferred from the URL when absent.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.fail-fast
properties.description: Abort startup when a DDL statement fails; false skips failed statements.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.alter-column
properties.description: ALTER columns whose type differs from the entity.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.drop-extra-columns
properties.description: Drop database columns that no longer exist on the entity. Dangerous; keep off in shared schemas.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.create-index
properties.description: Create missing secondary indexes.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.quote-identifiers
properties.description: Quote identifiers with dialect-specific quotes in generated DDL.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.show-sql
properties.description: Log every executed DDL statement.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.dry-run
properties.description: Plan only; never executes DDL and never opens the DataSource.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.catalog
properties.description: JDBC catalog for metadata lookups; defaults to the connection catalog.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.schema
properties.description: JDBC schema for metadata lookups; defaults to the connection schema.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.table-prefix
properties.description: Prefix applied to managed table names and FK reference targets.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.index-prefix-enabled
properties.description: Whether auto-derived index names include the table prefix.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.foreign-keys
properties.description: Emit FOREIGN KEY constraints; disable for engines like GBase 8a.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.auto-increment
properties.description: Emit auto-increment clauses; disable for engines like DuckDB.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.postgres-identity-style
properties.description: PostgreSQL identity style: IDENTITY or SERIAL (for old OpenGauss).

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.phase
properties.description: When to run: eager = during context refresh before traffic; ready = after the ApplicationReadyEvent (2.0.1 behaviour).

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.lock
properties.description: Take a dialect metadata lock (MySQL GET_LOCK / PG pg_advisory_lock) before executing, so concurrent instances start serially.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.history
properties.description: Record applied changes into the history table.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.history-table
properties.description: History table name.

properties.name: jkit.sql.auto.export
properties.description: Write the planned DDL to this file (UTF-8, one statement per line) on every run.
